summary.en: U.S. futures rise as investors digest President Trump's peace deal signal with Iran and await SpaceX IPO debut; oil prices fall while gold surges on geopolitical risk-off, creating mixed sentiment ahead of open.
summary.zh: 美国期指上扬的背景下，投资者关注特朗普总统关于与伊朗签署和平协议的信号以及等待 SpaceX 的首次公开募股（IPO）表现；油价下跌而黄金在避险情绪推动下上涨，盘前呈现多空交织格局。

title.en: U.S.-Iran Peace Deal Nears: Trump Signals 'Soon' on Agreement
title.zh: 美伊和平协议临近：特朗普表示"即将签署"

topNews.impact: Potential de-escalation in Middle East reduces oil supply disruption fears and geopolitical risk premium; positive for equities, negative energy complex.

macroRisk.en: Oil prices fall → lower inflation expectations → 10Y yields stabilize; reduces tail risk for rate-sensitive growth stocks.
macroRisk.zh: 油价下跌→通胀预期降温→10Y美债收益率企稳；降低对利率敏感的成长股尾部风险。

title.en: SpaceX IPO Valuation Surpasses $2 Trillion Milestone
title.zh: SpaceX 估值超越 2 万亿美元里程碑

topNews.impact: Historic valuation milestone highlights tech innovation leadership; could catalyze broader EV/automation rally.

macroRisk.en: $2 trillion market cap milestone underscores autonomous mobility and aerospace innovation confidence.
macroRisk.zh: $2 万亿美元市值里程碑突显自动驾驶和航空航天创新信心。

title.en: Gold Surges 3% as Risk-Off Flows Accelerate
title.zh: 黄金上涨 3%，避险资金加速涌入

topNews.impact: Geopolitical risk premium compression eases immediate tension; flight to safety supports precious metals while pressuring energy.

macroRisk.en: Higher real yields + inflation expectations moderate gold price; Fed hawkishness on energy transition keeps pressure but safe-haven demand remains structural.
macroRisk.zh: 实际收益率上升叠加通胀预期削弱金价；美联储对能源转型的鹰派言论压制黄金，但避险需求仍是结构性因素。

title.en: NVIDIA Post-Earnings Pressure: $91B Market Cap Slide
title.zh: 英伟达财报后承压：市值蒸发 910 亿美元

topNews.impact: Despite record Q1 fiscal revenue of $81.6B, stock faces profit-taking; AI chip demand remains strong but short-term volatility elevated.

macroRisk.en: $91B market cap slide reflects short-term profit-taking on record earnings; valuation compression amid AI sector rotation and potential regulatory scrutiny.
macroRisk.zh: 市值蒸发 9,100亿美元反映记录性收益后的短期获利了结；AI板块轮动及龙头可能面临监管审查压制估值。

title.en: Treasury Yields Edge Higher on Fed Rate Timing Uncertainty
title.zh: 美债收益率小幅攀升，美联储降息时点存疑

topNews.impact: Yield curve dynamics reflect mixed macro signals; watch for yield breakouts that could trigger rotation out of duration.

macroRisk.en: Yield curve dynamics reflect mixed macro signals; Fed timing uncertainty creates volatility in duration assets and bond portfolio allocations.
macroRisk.zh: 收益率曲线反映混杂的宏观信号；美联储时点不确定性导致久期资产波动，影响债券配置。

ai.en: AI sector showing mixed signals post-NVDA volatility; chip demand remains robust per TrendForce, but short-term profit-taking on leader weakness.
ai.zh: 英伟达波动后 AI 板块呈现多空交织信号；芯片需求仍强劲（根据 TrendForce），但龙头走弱引发短期获利了结。

semiconductor.en: TSMC and major foundries report strong Q1 revenue growth driven by AI demand; AVGO benefits from diversified portfolio as NVDA corrects.
semiconductor.zh: 台积电及主要代工厂凭借强劲需求报告一季度收入增长；AVGO 受益于多元化组合，NVDA 回调时显现韧性。

bigTech.en: Mixed sentiment: MSFT/GOOGL hold steady, META faces AI ad-revenue scrutiny; NVDA correction creates rotation opportunities into peers.
bigTech.zh: 多空交织：MSFT/GOOGL 维持稳定，META 面临 AI 广告收入审查；NVDA回调为轮动至同业的良机。

energy.en: Oil price decline on de-escalation hopes weighs on XLE; production cuts and OPEC+ dynamics may provide support if geopolitical risk premium compresses further.
energy.zh: 油价下跌拖累能源板块；减产和欧佩克 + 动态可能在地缘风险溢价进一步压缩时提供支持。

ev.en: Tesla gains alongside SpaceX milestone; broader auto sector benefits from robotics/automation narrative despite macro headwinds.
ev.zh: 特斯拉随 SpaceX里程碑上涨；更广泛的汽车板块受益于机器人/自动化叙事，尽管存在宏观经济逆风。

market.en: S&P/Nasdaq futures rise on geopolitical de-escalation hopes; breadth mixed as energy weakness offsets AI strength.
market.zh: 期指随地缘缓和希望而上扬；广度分化，能源疲软抵消了科技股强势。

preciousMetals.en: Gold +3% on Middle East tension easing and flight-to-safety flows; silver follows suit as industrial demand remains subdued.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金上涨 3%，源于中东紧张局势缓和及避险资金流入；白银跟随，工业需求仍疲软。

oil.en: WTI/Brent decline reflects de-escalation hopes; watch for OPEC+ statements and Middle East supply disruptions.
oil.zh: 油价下跌反映缓和希望；关注欧佩克 + 声明及中东供应中断风险。

futures.en: S&P/E-mini futures +0.2%, Nasdaq gains; broad market lifted by geopolitical easing.
futures.zh: 标普/小型盘期指上涨，纳斯达克走高；市场在地缘缓和提振下上行。

treasury10Y.en: Watch for yields responding to peace deal signals and Fed speaker commentary today.
treasury10Y.zh: 关注收益率对和平协议信号及美联储发言人评论的响应。

oil.en: WTI trading lower on geopolitical de-escalation.
oil.zh: WTI 油价随地缘缓和下跌交易。

keyRisk.en: Fed speakers monitoring policy stance; ensure inflation control remains anchored despite oil downside.
keyRisk.zh: 美联储发言人监控政策立场；确保通胀控制锚定在油价下行之际依然稳固。

note.en: Mixed sentiment with risk-off in energy/precious metals offsetting equity gains from geopolitical easing; AI chips show underlying strength despite short-term volatility.
note.zh: 多空交织：能源和贵金属的避险情绪抵消了地缘缓和带来的权益收益；AI 芯片尽管短期波动仍展现底层韧性。
